item.text: The installed-package parsers use `strings.Fields`, which removes the empty release field. Amazon Linux 2 also uses that collapsed field count to choose a parser. The source filename parser splits from the right without checking that the resulting parts form a valid RPM name. I’m adding regression cases for these boundaries before editing the parser.

EOF'
